title: All-perovskite tandem solar cell built with laser polishing achieves 29.80% efficiency
content: Chinese researchers developed an all-perovskite tandem solar cell using a non-contact laser polishing strategy that reduces surface defects and improves charge extraction in lead-tin perovskite films.
